add-device PC1 end
add-device PC2 end
add-device R1 router
add-port PC1 aa:aa:aa:aa:aa:01 10.0.0.1/24
add-port R1 aa:00:00:00:00:01 10.0.0.254/24
add-port PC2 aa:aa:aa:aa:aa:02 10.0.1.1/24
add-port R1 aa:00:00:00:00:02 10.0.1.254/24
connect PC1:0 R1:0
connect R1:1 PC2:0
set-gateway PC1 10.0.0.254
acl R1 in deny 10.0.0.0/24 10.0.1.0/24 icmp
ping PC1 10.0.1.1
run 200
set-link R1:1 mtu 576
udp-send PC1 10.0.1.1 7 df 
run 200
drop-stats R1
